verdict.rationale: The axis applies to Square, a POS and payments product with card-reader hardware, but no evidence item documents pairing a reader with the POS app, registering a device to an account, or how quickly a first payment can be taken. The Terminal API, Point of Sale API, and Mobile Payments SDK items describe developer building blocks for connecting custom software. Tap to Pay on iPhone explicitly needs no reader, so it is an adjacent feature. Under the rubric none of these earn credit, so the reviewer's concern is valid.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes
